pr.title: Hear no UNREVIEWED in a repository whose review.automatic is false
pr.head: afff60822aed12f5e5ad0073f9a04c8b36b6a482

summary: The Projector watch daemon is a background process that polls the pull requests a session subscribes to and sends each session one-line events. A session that fixes a pull request, its fixer, hears an UNREVIEWED line once per head when the pull request is ready for review, its head is not signed off, and no session the daemon can see is reviewing it.

In a repository where pull requests get a Projector review only when someone asks for one, that line arrives for every ready pull request and tells the user nothing new. This pull request adds a repository setting, review.automatic, a boolean that defaults to true. When it is false, the daemon sends no UNREVIEWED line for that repository's pull requests. Every other fixer event still arrives.

• Where the daemon reads it: the same places it already reads review.ci and review.reviewers. That is a checkout of the repository that a live session works in, or otherwise the .projector.toml committed on the default branch, layered under ~/.projector.toml.
  • Refactor: the daemon kept these per-repository settings as a (reviewers, ci) tuple. They are now a small frozen ReviewSettings dataclass, so callers read named fields instead of indexes.

groups.title: The daemon reads the setting and holds back the line
groups.kicker: The settings dataclass, the new config key, and the check in route_fix
intro: review_settings turns a loaded configuration into a ReviewSettings. automatic is off only when the key is explicitly false, so a missing key, a repository with no .projector.toml, and a failed read all leave it on.
route_fix builds the fixer's events for one pull request. The new test sits in the outer condition beside the draft and reviewer checks, so it holds back only the UNREVIEWED line and no other event.

files.note: Registers review.automatic as a known boolean key, so project config get and set accept it.
Adds ReviewSettings, moves every reader of the old tuple to its fields, and checks automatic before sending UNREVIEWED.

checks.text: Every reader of the old tuple (committed_settings, settings_of, counted_logins, reviewed_in_ci) now reads the dataclass. A search of src and tests found no other index into it.

Unlike a hold-back for review.ci, this check sits in the outer condition, so the head's announced key is dropped rather than kept. Setting automatic back to true on the same head sends the line again. The comment above it says a held-back head keeps its key, and the review listed that mismatch as a suggestion.

files.note: One repository commits automatic = false and another commits nothing. Only the second hears UNREVIEWED.

checks.text: The test fails if the automatic check is removed from route_fix, and also if the setting reaches the other repository. The check job passed on this head.

groups.title: Documentation and the fix-pr skill
groups.kicker: The configuration table, the event table, and what fixers tell the user
intro: docs/cli.md adds the key to the configuration table and names the new exception in the UNREVIEWED row of the event table. When the fix-pr skill relays an UNREVIEWED line, it now tells the user that project config set review.automatic false in the repository's checkout stops these lines. It also counts such a repository among those that report nothing.

files.note: Documents the key and the event's new exception.

checks.text: The sentence "A repository that commits none has neither setting" now covers three settings. The review suggested rewording it.

files.note: Tells the fixer to name the setting when it relays an UNREVIEWED line.
